ios.desc:
Introducing Kindest, the personal relationship manager designed to help you build and grow stronger connections with the people you care about.

With Kindest, you can manage and keep track of all your relationships, and set actions to nurture them. Whether it's a daily check-in, weekly date night, a birthday celebration, or a hug, Kindest reminds you and helps you plan and keep track of all important actions and events to build happy relationships.

Add Relationships
Create a record of important people in your life. With the progress ring feature, you can visually track your actions, turning relationship building into a fun and rewarding game.

Set Actions
Set daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or one-time actions with a customizable reminder to never forget to show your loved ones you care. Customize actions with unique icons, colors, and details, and get motivated by streak.

Keep Memories
Create Memories with images or text notes that remind you of special moments or important details. These can be linked to individual relationships or actions, helping you keep track of everything that matters.

Self-care
And let's not forget about you. With Kindest, you can set actions and memories for yourself, transforming the app into a personal self-care tracker. Whether it's meditating, doing yoga, or just taking some time off, Kindest is here to ensure you don't forget to take care of yourself. 

Get Inspired
Discover dozens of action templates for various relationship categories, from family and friends to romantic partners and colleagues, and get inspired to take action.

Privacy first
With Kindest you stay private. No sharing of your identity or any records, or contacts.

Kindest Plus
Start for free or subscribe to Kindest Plus to unlock unlimited features.
